visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with black hair, wearing a mustard-yellow t-shirt and white floral shorts, is seen sitting on the floor in a hallway lined with translucent plastic storage bins. She looks towards the left, appearing anxious as she adjusts her position against a wooden door. (2) The scene cuts to the girl moving quickly towards a white door, attempting to hide behind it. She holds a large white paper shopping bag on the floor. A second, slightly older girl in a striped shirt and olive shorts is briefly visible in the background, looking around a corner while the younger girl ducks. (3) The setting changes to a brightly lit bedroom with a wooden floor and white walls. The young girl in yellow is now hiding under a striped brown and white duvet on a low-profile bed. Her face is visible as she peeks out, smiling. The older girl finds her, leading to mutual laughter and jumping on the mattress. (4) The young girl is seen covering her eyes with her hands while standing on a large white flower-shaped plush cushion in a living room area, counting. The room contains various toys, storage cabinets, and a television. (5) She then walks through various rooms, including an office area with a white desk, a laptop, and a printer, searching for her companion. She peeks behind wooden doors with a focused, serious expression. (6) She finds the older girl hiding behind a corner. They both celebrate with smiles and gestures. The young girl then hides her face behind a large flower pillow. (7) The video concludes with a solid pink screen featuring a small cartoon character and text logo.
